hypothesis_lifecycle.rule: failed versions are immutable; successors begin a new prospective epoch after the last design-evidence day; design evidence never counts as successor confirmation

notes: Specialists are challengers, not extra correlated production votes.
NO_ROBUST_ADVANTAGE freezes the failed version and creates at most one structurally distinct automatic successor.
A successor receives a new prospective evidence epoch; earlier design days are excluded from its evaluation counters.
READY_FOR_REVIEW freezes the exact rule and opens a separate forward-validation epoch from zero.
Qualification evidence and forward-validation evidence remain separate and cannot be double-counted.
After the automatic v2 successor fails, the family retires instead of threshold-chasing through repeated versions.
Intraday specialists require actual LIVE scans near their activation time; recovered or hindsight rows are excluded.
